action_items.task: Create and deliver written migration plan

decisions.text: Target Q4 for the migration with a Q1 buffer.
Use a dual-write period rather than a hard cutover for the rollback approach.
Do not hire a contractor for the migration project.

key_quotes: Then we're deciding to target Q4 with a Q1 buffer. I want that written down.
Decision: we do a dual-write period rather than a hard cutover.
We are not hiring a contractor for this. We tried that last year and onboarding ate the savings.
summary: The team aligned on the timeline and strategy for the upcoming migration during Q4 planning. They agreed to target a Q4 release with a Q1 buffer and utilize a dual-write period instead of a hard cutover. Additionally, the team decided against hiring external contractors for the project.
title: Q4 Planning
